observations: Used automatic transmission/gearbox unit sitting on wet, dirty ground
Bare metal casing with visible grime, oil residue, and corrosion in spots
Torque converter visible on one side (photo 0), valve body/harness and connectors visible on other side (photo 1)
A small white sticker is visible on the case in photo 1 but text is not legible enough to read a part number
Bystanders' feet and hands are in frame, consistent with a parts-yard environment
Seller watermark 'NEMZ AUTOSPARE PARTS' overlaid on both photos; this is the seller's branding, not proof of the part's origin or grade

identity.kind: automatic transmission/gearbox (claimed fit for Nissan Rogue/Altima)

claims.evidence: No import documentation, customs tag, or shipping label visible in either photo
No grading certificate or stamp visible; 'grade' terminology not shown on any tag in photos
Sticker in photo 1 is present but the text/part number is too small/blurry to confirm compatibility
No test clip, dipstick fluid check, or bench-test shown; static photos only

risks.risk: Internal gearbox condition (clutch packs, gears, torque converter wear) cannot be seen from outside
risks.proof: Video of the transmission being bench-tested or installed and shifting through gears
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / needing rebuild

risks.risk: Actual part number/compatibility with Rogue or Altima trims (CVT vs conventional auto differs by year)
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of the legible sticker/part number on the case
risks.if_unproven: priced as unconfirmed fitment, generic used transmission risk

risks.risk: Fluid condition and contamination (burnt fluid, metal shavings) not visible in dry/dirty photos
risks.proof: Photo of drained fluid on a clean rag or in a clear container

risks.risk: Mileage/age of donor vehicle unknown, affecting wear estimate
risks.proof: Photo of donor vehicle VIN plate or chassis tag matching the part

risks.risk: Electrical connectors/sensors (visible in photo 1) may be damaged or missing pins
risks.proof: Close-up photo of each connector showing intact pins and clips

proof_requests: Close-up, well-lit photo of the sticker/part-number tag on the case
Video of the gearbox output shaft being turned by hand or bench-tested
Photo of fluid drained from the unit
Photo of any VIN/chassis tag from the donor vehicle, if available
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a used automatic transmission by type, but all seller claims about origin, grade, and exact model fitment are unverifiable from the photos, so it must be priced at worst case as an unconfirmed-fitment, untested used gearbox.
